description:
This project entails repairs, by replacing, a portion of the potable and fire supply water system at AUTEC,
returning the system to the original design intent while updating the system to account for current use
characteristics. The items to be updated include two (2) finished water holding/contact tanks, an elevated storage
tank, and interconnecting piping. Two existing finished water tanks that have reached the end of their useful life
will be demolished, along with abandoned piping.
